tax_year.rationale: The tax year is a form-level attribute (TaxYr or TaxPeriodEndDt) on the filing header, not a leaf element within IRS1040NR; no matching candidate exists in the closed list.

taxpayer_name.rationale: The filer's name is carried in the ReturnHeader (PersonNm or BusinessNameLine1Txt), not in any IRS1040NR body element in the candidate list.

taxpayer_tin.rationale: The primary TIN (SSN/ITIN/EIN) lives in the ReturnHeader, not in any IRS1040NR body element in the candidate list.

address_in_home_country.rationale: Blueprint bundles street, city, province, postal code, and country into one string; canonical schema splits these across AddressLine1Txt/AddressLine2Txt/CityNm/ProvinceOrStateNm/ForeignPostalCd/CountryCd under SeparateMailingAddress/ForeignAddress (idx 101-106) — but those elements are under SeparateMailingAddress, not the primary filer foreign address block, and the blueprint should be split into at least 6 fields.

us_mailing_address.rationale: AddressLine1Txt under SeparateMailingAddress/USAddress best matches the U.S. street address line; blueprint should also surface AddressLine2Txt (idx 108) separately.

city_state_zip.rationale: Blueprint bundles city, state abbreviation, and ZIP into one string; canonical splits into CityNm (idx 109), StateAbbreviationCd (idx 110), and ZIPCd (idx 111) — blueprint should be refactored into three separate fields.

country_of_citizenship.rationale: Country of citizenship is not represented by any element in the closed candidate list for IRS1040NR body elements.

country_of_residence.rationale: Country of residence for tax purposes is not represented by any element in the closed candidate list.

visa_type.rationale: Visa type is not represented by any element in the closed candidate list.

alien_registration_number.rationale: Alien registration number is not represented by any element in the closed candidate list.

date_of_birth.rationale: Date of birth is typically a ReturnHeader or Schedule OI element; no matching candidate exists in the closed list.

residency_termination_date.rationale: Residency termination date is not represented by any element in the closed candidate list.

filing_status.rationale: IndividualReturnFilingStatusCd directly encodes the filing status checkbox selection.

spouse_name.rationale: SpouseNm maps directly to the spouse name line.

spouse_tin.rationale: Spouse TIN (SSN/ITIN) is not represented by any element in the closed candidate list.

exempt_individual_status.rationale: Exempt individual classification checkbox is not represented by any element in the closed candidate list.

number_of_days_in_us.rationale: Number of days present in the U.S. on page 1 is not represented by any element in the closed candidate list (Schedule OI day counts are different fields).

wages_salaries_tips.rationale: WagesSalariesAndTipsAmt directly corresponds to the wages, salaries, tips effectively connected income line.

taxable_interest.rationale: TaxableInterestAmt maps to the taxable interest line in the effectively connected income section.

ordinary_dividends.rationale: OrdinaryDividendsAmt maps to the ordinary dividends line in the income section.

qualified_dividends.rationale: QualifiedDividendsAmt maps to the qualified dividends sub-line.

taxable_refunds.rationale: Taxable refunds of state/local income taxes is not represented by any element in the closed candidate list.

business_income_loss.rationale: Business income or loss (Schedule C equivalent) is not represented by any element in the closed candidate list.

capital_gain_loss.rationale: CapitalGainLossAmt maps to the net capital gain or loss line in the income section.

other_gains_losses.rationale: Other gains or losses from Form 4797 is not represented by any element in the closed candidate list.

ira_distributions_taxable.rationale: TaxableIRAAmt maps to the taxable amount of IRA distributions line.

pensions_annuities_taxable.rationale: TotalTaxablePensionsAmt maps to the taxable amount of pensions and annuities line.

rental_royalty_income.rationale: Rental/royalty/partnership/S-corp income from Schedule E is not represented by any element in the closed candidate list.

farm_income.rationale: Farm income or loss from Schedule F is not represented by any element in the closed candidate list.

unemployment_compensation.rationale: Unemployment compensation is not represented by any element in the closed candidate list.

other_income.rationale: Other effectively connected income (catch-all line) is not represented by any single element in the closed candidate list; TotalAdditionalIncomeAmt (idx 138) is a subtotal, not the line itself.

total_effectively_connected_income.rationale: TotalECIAmt maps to the total effectively connected income subtotal line.

educator_expenses.rationale: Educator expenses deduction is not represented by any element in the closed candidate list.

student_loan_interest_deduction.rationale: Student loan interest deduction is not represented by any element in the closed candidate list.

self_employed_sep_simple_plans.rationale: SEP/SIMPLE/qualified plans deduction is not represented by any element in the closed candidate list.

self_employed_health_insurance.rationale: Self-employed health insurance deduction is not represented by any element in the closed candidate list.

ira_deduction.rationale: IRA deduction is not represented by any element in the closed candidate list.

total_adjustments.rationale: TotalAdjustmentsAmt maps directly to the total adjustments to income line.

adjusted_gross_income.rationale: AdjustedGrossIncomeAmt maps directly to the AGI line.

itemized_deductions.rationale: TotalItemizedDeductionsAmt maps to the itemized deductions total from Schedule A.

qualified_business_income_deduction.rationale: QualifiedBusinessIncomeDedAmt maps to the Section 199A QBI deduction line.

total_deductions.rationale: TotalDeductionAmt maps to the total deductions line.

taxable_income.rationale: TaxableIncomeAmt maps directly to the taxable income line.

tax_from_tax_table_or_computation.rationale: TaxAmt maps to the computed income tax on effectively connected taxable income line.

alternative_minimum_tax.rationale: Alternative minimum tax from Form 6251 is not represented by any element in the closed candidate list.

net_investment_income_tax.rationale: Net investment income tax from Form 8960 is not represented by any element in the closed candidate list.

additional_medicare_tax.rationale: Additional Medicare tax from Form 8959 is not represented by any element in the closed candidate list.

tax_on_income_not_effectively_connected.rationale: IncomeNotUSBusinessTaxAmt maps to the tax on non-effectively-connected (FDAP) income at flat rate.

total_tax.rationale: TotalTaxAmt maps directly to the total tax line.

child_tax_credit.rationale: CTCODCAmt represents the combined child tax credit / credit for other dependents, which is the closest match to the child tax credit line.

education_credits.rationale: Education credits from Form 8863 are not represented by any element in the closed candidate list.

foreign_tax_credit.rationale: Foreign tax credit from Form 1116 is not represented by any element in the closed candidate list.

general_business_credit.rationale: General business credit from Form 3800 is not represented by any element in the closed candidate list.

retirement_savings_contribution_credit.rationale: Retirement savings contribution credit from Form 8880 is not represented by any element in the closed candidate list.

total_credits.rationale: TotalCreditsAmt maps directly to the total credits line.

other_taxes.rationale: OtherTaxAmtInd is the closest indicator for other taxes; however the repeating group OtherTaxAmtGrp/OtherTaxAmt (idx 70) may be more appropriate — blueprint should be refactored to handle a repeating group rather than a single scalar.

federal_income_tax_withheld.rationale: WithholdingTaxAmt maps to the total federal income tax withheld line aggregating W-2, 1042-S, and 1099 withholding.

estimated_tax_payments.rationale: EstimatedTaxPaymentsAmt maps to the estimated tax payments line.

earned_income_credit.rationale: Earned income credit is not represented by any element in the closed candidate list.

additional_child_tax_credit.rationale: AdditionalChildTaxCreditAmt maps to the additional child tax credit line from Schedule 8812.

american_opportunity_credit.rationale: Refundable American opportunity credit from Form 8863 is not represented by any element in the closed candidate list.

other_payments_credits.rationale: TotalOtherPaymentsRfdblCrAmt maps to the other refundable credits and payments line.

total_payments.rationale: TotalPaymentsAmt maps directly to the total payments line.

overpayment.rationale: OverpaidAmt maps to the overpayment line.

refund_amount.rationale: RefundAmt maps to the refund line (amount to be refunded).

amount_applied_to_next_year.rationale: AppliedToEsTaxAmt maps to the amount applied to next year's estimated tax.

amount_owed.rationale: OwedAmt maps to the amount you owe (balance due) line.

estimated_tax_penalty.rationale: EsPenaltyAmt maps to the estimated tax underpayment penalty line.

routing_number.rationale: RoutingTransitNum maps to the bank routing number for direct deposit.

account_number.rationale: DepositorAccountNum maps to the bank account number for direct deposit.

account_type.rationale: BankAccountTypeCd maps to the checking/savings account type checkbox.

third_party_designee.rationale: ThirdPartyDesigneeInd maps to the yes/no third-party designee checkbox.

third_party_designee_name.rationale: ThirdPartyDesigneeNm maps to the third-party designee name field.

third_party_designee_phone.rationale: ThirdPartyDesigneePhoneNum maps to the third-party designee phone number field.

occupation_in_us.rationale: PrimaryOccupationTxt maps to the occupation line in the signature section.

preparer_name.rationale: Paid preparer name is in the ReturnHeader/Preparer section, not in any IRS1040NR body element in the candidate list.

preparer_ptin.rationale: Preparer PTIN is in the ReturnHeader/Preparer section, not in any IRS1040NR body element in the candidate list.

preparer_self_employed.rationale: Preparer self-employed checkbox is in the ReturnHeader/Preparer section, not in any IRS1040NR body element in the candidate list.

preparer_firm_name.rationale: Preparer firm name is in the ReturnHeader/Preparer section, not in any IRS1040NR body element in the candidate list.

preparer_firm_ein.rationale: Preparer firm EIN is in the ReturnHeader/Preparer section, not in any IRS1040NR body element in the candidate list.

preparer_firm_address.rationale: Preparer firm address is in the ReturnHeader/Preparer section, not in any IRS1040NR body element in the candidate list.

preparer_phone.rationale: Preparer phone number is in the ReturnHeader/Preparer section, not in any IRS1040NR body element in the candidate list.

preparer_signature_date.rationale: Preparer signature date is in the ReturnHeader/Preparer section, not in any IRS1040NR body element in the candidate list.

schedule_oi_days_present_current_year.rationale: Schedule OI day counts are on a separate schedule attachment, not represented by any element in the IRS1040NR body candidate list.

schedule_oi_days_present_prior_year_1.rationale: Schedule OI prior-year-1 day count is not represented by any element in the closed candidate list.

schedule_oi_days_present_prior_year_2.rationale: Schedule OI prior-year-2 day count is not represented by any element in the closed candidate list.

schedule_oi_income_exempt_treaty.rationale: Schedule OI treaty exemption yes/no indicator is not represented by any element in the closed candidate list.

schedule_oi_treaty_country.rationale: Schedule OI treaty country name is not represented by any element in the closed candidate list.

schedule_oi_treaty_article.rationale: Schedule OI treaty article number is not represented by any element in the closed candidate list.

schedule_oi_treaty_exempt_amount.rationale: TreatyTaxExemptUSIncomeAmt is the closest match to the dollar amount of income exempt under a treaty, though it may be a body-level aggregate rather than the Schedule OI line specifically.

schedule_oi_type_of_exempt_income.rationale: Description of the type of treaty-exempt income on Schedule OI is not represented by any element in the closed candidate list.

schedule_oi_student_or_apprentice.rationale: Schedule OI student/apprentice checkbox is not represented by any element in the closed candidate list.

schedule_oi_teacher_researcher.rationale: Schedule OI teacher/researcher checkbox is not represented by any element in the closed candidate list.

schedule_oi_occupation.rationale: Schedule OI occupation line is not represented by any element in the closed candidate list.

owns_foreign_financial_account.rationale: Foreign financial account FBAR question on Schedule OI is not represented by any element in the closed candidate list.

foreign_financial_account_country.rationale: Foreign financial account country on Schedule OI is not represented by any element in the closed candidate list.

fdap_income_items.rationale: FDAP income is represented as a repeating schedule (page 4) not directly captured by any single element in the closed candidate list; blueprint's array structure also structurally mismatches any single scalar candidate.
